  path={"/plugins/{id}/restore-bundled"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Drops any update downloaded over a plugin that ships with Termix and loads the copy from the image again, so a broken release can be rolled back from the layout repair view. The shipped version is pinned so auto update does not bring the release back. Dependents restart.
